messages:
samir: hey team — first day, onboarding checklist told me to enroll my laptop but it got stuck. MDM status shows "Awaiting user approval" and macOS update got interrupted. FileVault says "Encryption paused". I can't get past the enrolment screen. anyone seen this? :wave:

kelly-it: welcome! :wave: can you confirm macOS version and whether you were on wifi or ethernet during enrollment? also do you see the system prompt to approve the MDM profile under System Settings > Privacy & Security?

samir: on wifi, version shows 13.4.1 in About This Mac. I don't see a profile prompt — the company MDM page in System Settings is blank. tried rebooting once already.

marie: @samir did you accept the network captive portal at the office wifi? sometimes the update hangs if network access isn't fully open.

samir: i'm on home wifi right now (working remotely). no captive portal. i put it on charger and rebooted twice. still same.

kelly-it: ok. don't give yourself permanent admin rights, we'll avoid that. can you run these and paste the output? (we can do a short screen share if you prefer)

```
/usr/sbin/fdesetup status
/usr/bin/profiles status -type enrollment
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
```

samir: pasted outputs below — hope this helps:

```
$ /usr/sbin/fdesetup status
FileVault is On.
Encryption in progress: 42% complete

$ /usr/bin/profiles status -type enrollment
No enrolled provisioning profiles found.

$ sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
profiles: error - No provisioning profile was found
```

kelly-it: thanks. looks like FileVault is still encrypting and the MDM profile never completed. encryption at 42% can slow down enrollment. please leave the laptop plugged in for a bit and don't close the lid. i'm going to open an IT ticket so we can push the enrollment command from our MDM server and monitor encryption.

kelly-it: filing ticket now — will also request a temporary one-time admin session via our remote tool so we can run the renewal commands safely. @marie can you confirm the buddy onboarding checklist step for remote folks (screen share vs scheduled drop-in)?

marie: yeah — we usually do a 15-min screenshare. i'll send a calendar invite for 15:30 your time.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance: MDM server will attempt a reconciliation push in 10 minutes (ID: mdm-recon-2026-03-23).

samir: sounds good, i'll leave it open and join the screenshare. thanks! :thumbsup:

kelly-it: one more thing — if the MDM push doesn't register in ~30m we may temporarily escalate to a 'user-approved MDM' re-enroll flow. we'll coordinate and keep this thread updated. for now, keep the laptop awake and online.

samir: noted. appreciate the quick help.

kelly-it: np — ping here if the encryption hits 100% or you get any profile prompts.

marie: welcome aboard again! coffee on me when you're in the office. :coffee:

samir: excited to be here, thanks everyone!
